description: Find CEM research by words or code in CRP's public search index (GET /search/index.json): papers, playbooks, case studies, book chapters, figures, calculators and pages. Every word must match the title, full title, summary or code. Returns each result's code, title, kind and address.

kind.description: Only this kind, as the index names it, e.g. "Playbook", "Tool", "Page"

query.description: Words or a code, e.g. "drift tax", "DOI-07", "PB-011"

name: research_search
title: Search the research
